scope: Complete bounded corrected working manuscript using existing synthetic material only; no new experiment or outside claim.

requests.action: Replace universal 2x end-to-end/no-regression claim; state small 1.25x, medium 1.20x, large 0.90909x with 10% latency regression, and kernel-only 2x. Keep included kernel timing separate; never add scopes.
acceptance: Abstract, Results and Appendix agree with scope and all three end-to-end ratios.

requests.action: Choose existing-data resolution: scope every performance conclusion to one-run descriptive CPU observations. Explicitly preserve no independent repeats, variance/quality unmeasured, and no GPU measurement. No CI/significance/quality-preservation/repeatability assertion.
acceptance: Scope explicitly remains descriptive, or new independently collected evidence and precommitted analysis justify the revised claim without fabricated CI.

requests.action: Keep original rejection: Appendix A already discloses regression. Retain that disclosure; do not claim the revision repaired a hidden/omitted result.
acceptance: Existing appendix and CSV directly refute missing-disclosure suspicion.

deliverables: Per-finding evidence/change mapping with old/new hashes, exact locations and preserved CSV identity
protocol: Successfully publish revision artifact refs before consuming review request. Reviewer later independently reads old/new/data and evaluates original acceptance; no receipt closes findings.
limits: No modification of frozen original artifacts
At most two revisions; report unresolved instead of invented closure
